Sameer Suri a.k.a. Sammy a.k.a. Saand

It will explode if it exceeds 100db.

D-15 to election, daughter has vanished.

a drop of booze wont kill you

...when the running stops and the bullets begin

Police Capt. Martin, San Diego Police

There's a method to her madness.
